## What happened, and what you expected instead

## How to reproduce it

<!-- The exact command, or the exact page and what you clicked. If it is in the
     map or a manual, the URL — `?deck=<slug>`, `?mode=explore`, `#the-kill` —
     because mode and deck change almost everything. -->

## Which half

- [ ] The card map / deck dossier (`viz/`)
- [ ] A deck page (`manuals/`, the legacy renderer)
- [ ] The pipeline (`manamap run`, or one step)
- [ ] A pilot subcommand (`manamap pilot …`)
- [ ] The tests
- [ ] Docs

## Environment

<!-- Only if you ran Python. `python --version` (must be 3.10), OS, and whether
     you have run the pipeline — a great many commands need `data/cards.csv`,
     which is gitignored and only exists after `manamap extract`. -->

## Anything you already ruled out

<!-- Genuinely useful and usually skipped. What you checked that turned out fine
     saves the next person from checking it again. -->
